title: Z9.F shift degree — Low operator degree forces the quotient to vanish
milestone_description: Let $n\ge1$ and $H\in\mathbb Q[X]$ satisfy $\operatorname{natdeg}H\le7n-3$ and $\operatorname{natdeg}D_n(H)\le8$. Then $H=0$. No nonzero-input premise or kernel equation is assumed: the original low operator degree and quotient degree bound yield a contradiction if $H\ne0$. Zero input, constant input and the $n=1,X^5$ resonance are preserved by exact boundary checks. These polynomial facts do not by themselves state a rational telescoper relationship, coefficient-map inverse or zeta irrationality.
